🌎 BEYOND THE 956

SAFETY HARBOR, Fla. — A 40-year-old Florida man has been charged with first-degree murder after authorities say he shot his girlfriend outside a bar in Safety Harbor and ran over her body as he fled — with his 5-year-old daughter and the family dog in the vehicle.

According to the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office and the arrest affidavit, Christopher "Dodge" Smith arrived at the Harbor Bar on Main Street just before 9 p.m. on Tuesday, October 13, leaving his young daughter and their dog in the parking lot while he went inside looking for Jessica Antolini, 30. Witnesses told detectives Smith was acting "possessed" and appeared to be hunting Antolini down.

Deputies say Smith found Antolini and the two argued outside. When she followed him toward his SUV, he allegedly pulled a handgun and shot her in the face — a round that passed through her left eye and out the back of her skull, according to the affidavit. He then allegedly ran over Antolini's body as he drove away.

Antolini was taken to a hospital, where she died Thursday, October 15, at 9:14 p.m. — two days after the attack. Smith was first arrested Tuesday night on charges of attempted first-degree murder and child abuse; after Antolini's death, prosecutors upgraded the case to first-degree murder. He is being held without bond at the Pinellas County Jail.

Deputies located the SUV after Smith failed to stop for them. Bodycam, dashcam and aerial video released by the sheriff's office show officers using a PIT maneuver to bring the pursuit to an end. The child and the dog were unharmed.

The affidavit says Smith called his mother afterward, telling her he had "messed up" and was bringing his daughter over — and that the 5-year-old repeatedly told investigators, "Daddy shot Jess." Webb Watch 956 is not naming the child. The Pinellas County Sheriff's Office described the dispute as domestic-related and said the investigation is ongoing.

The charges are allegations, and Smith is presumed innocent unless and until he is convicted in court.

Sources: Pinellas County Sheriff's Office arrest affidavit; Tampa Bay Beacons, Oct. 17, 2026; americanalmanac.com, Oct. 17, 2026; New York Post, Oct. 18, 2026; People, via affidavit; WorldStar (@worldstar) on Instagram, Oct. 19, 2026.

title: Beyond the 956: Florida man charged with first-degree murder after girlfriend shot outside Safety Harbor bar and run over — his 5-year-old was in the car
